item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Taking it consistently matters more than taking it perfectly. Missed doses and guessed timing quietly undo progress. Check that your routine is simple, repeatable, and tied to something you already do every day. If something isn't working, such as side effects or doubts, don't adjust it on your own. Bring it to your prescriber. Your action: set one daily reminder for your dose and take it at that same time today.
